headline: Executive order on providing compensation to Americans who worked on the nation's nuclear weapons programs.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with paying compensation to people who worked on America's nuclear weapons. No summary was provided, so details such as who qualifies, how much is paid, and which agencies run the program are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Current and former nuclear weapons workers
who_it_affects.how: The order concerns compensation for people who worked on the nation's nuclear weapons programs.
Agencies would likely carry out the compensation effort, though the title does not say which ones.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 7, 2000; the effective date is not stated in the provided material.
